chunks: And the House was placed in the middle of the earth because it is the place from beneath which the earth was spread out, and so that the obligation would be equal in that for the people of the East and the West.

key_terms.الْبَيْتُ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْفَرْضُ: the religious obligation, here referring to hajj
key_terms.دُحِيَتِ الْأَرْضُ: the earth was spread out from there
key_terms.وَسَطِ الْأَرْضِ: the middle or center of the earth

ai.seo_question: Why was the Ka'bah placed in the center of the earth according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the placement of the Ka'bah as being in the center of the earth, identifying it as the point from beneath which the earth was spread out. It also states that this placement makes the obligation of hajj equitable for people living in both the East and the West.
